group.prompt:
Aim to create one ordered sequential story-image group with one image for each of these 5 narrative shots.
Preserve the numbered action order even if the active tool controls the actual return count.
Treat the frames as neighboring moments of one continuous action, not unrelated variants.
Keep the same character identity, scene state, visual style, camera setup, lighting, scale, and screen direction unless a shot explicitly allows a change.

HARD CONTINUITY LOCKS — preserve these in every frame:
characters:
- Girl has amber-gold eyes and waist-length straight deep-indigo hair; Boy has warm gray-brown eyes and half-tied black hair with natural fringe; both are youthful adults and preserve approved faces
wardrobe:
- Girl wears moon-white Chinese right-lapel top and deep-indigo mamian skirt with thin cinnabar accents; Boy wears rice-white Chinese right-lapel robe, blue-gray sleeveless outer layer and indigo sash
scene:
- ancient Chinese Jiangnan canal town with white walls, black tiled roofs, stone bridge, willow and riverside painting stall; no modern or Japanese elements
camera:
- 16:9 cinematic frame with layered foreground midground background and stable screen direction within the sequence
style:
- original New Gongbi cinematic 2D animation, meticulous Chinese line art, blue-green mineral pigments, subtle silk grain, crisp contrast, cool shadows and clean golden highlights, never sepia
props:
- exactly one old deep-indigo Chinese oil-paper umbrella with bamboo ribs and wooden handle; gold sun appears only on its inner surface when specified

ORDERED ACTION FRAMES:
1. [frame_25 | setup] Wide bridge recovery as dark peacock-blue rain clouds arrive and first large drops strike stone, both characters beside the caught umbrella, cool dramatic light.
   change only: pose, expression, gaze, moving prop position, secondary motion
2. [frame_26 | anticipation] Boy crouches slightly shielding the half-painted gold inner umbrella surface with his body and sleeve, worried about wet pigment, rain strengthening.
   change only: pose, expression, gaze, moving prop position, secondary motion
3. [frame_27 | action] Girl decisively takes the umbrella shaft from him and starts to push it open, medium two-shot, bamboo ribs still mostly folded.
   change only: pose, expression, gaze, moving prop position, secondary motion
4. [frame_28 | apex_or_contact] Opening action phase: umbrella canopy halfway expanded overhead, Girl braces the shaft, Boy ducks closer, rain streaks and wet stone reflections.
   change only: pose, expression, gaze, moving prop position, secondary motion
5. [frame_29 | recovery] Recovery under fully open umbrella: both young adults stand close but not touching, gold sun on inner canopy warmly illuminates their faces, heavy cool rain outside.
   change only: pose, expression, gaze, moving prop position, secondary motion

AVOID:
- different character identity
- face drift
- wardrobe changes
- extra characters
- extra limbs or fingers
- duplicate moving props
- unplanned camera or background changes
- text or watermark

resultPolicy.onShortfall: assign valid returns, then generate only unfilled shots
